# Native build of the C sources generated by TeaVM (gradle generateC).
# Gradle copies this file into build/generated/teavm/c, next to all.txt.
# Adapted from the one of the PlantUML TeaVM C experiment.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Release by default. This must come before project(): with MSVC, project()
# itself sets CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE to Debug when it is empty.
if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "")
	set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
endif()

project(luaj_poc C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)

if (MSVC)
	# TeaVM's runtime detects Windows through _MSC_VER: use MSVC or clang-cl.
	add_compile_options(/utf-8 /bigobj /W0)
else()
	set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O2")
	add_compile_options(-w)
endif()

# all.txt lists every generated .c file (all.c is the same set as a single unit)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/all.txt)
file(STRINGS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/all.txt TEAVM_GEN_FILE_LIST)
foreach(F IN LISTS TEAVM_GEN_FILE_LIST)
	list(APPEND TEAVM_GEN_SOURCES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/${F})
endforeach()

add_executable(poc-c ${TEAVM_GEN_SOURCES})

if (WIN32)
	# nothing to link
else()
	target_link_libraries(poc-c m rt)
endif()
